Described all 32 selected public functions; excluded static functions and the synthetic top-level node from operations. Used context.json and graph.json to inspect callers, includes, and private dependency components. Read relevant caller sites in frontend, compiler, generate, parse, protocol, build, main, macros, meta-sdk, meta-native, meta-project, and meta-group, plus supporting source for Scope callback execution, AST macros, SourceView, package lookup, path identity, child compiler ownership, and effect installation. The two graph-isolated shutdown helpers have resolved function-value entry paths and explicit attachments. Responsibilities describe concrete work within a shared private dependency component; they do not propose promoting helpers or splitting that component across translation units. Arbitrary source-defined and loaded-provider execution remains indirectly covered, as recorded in constraints. No files were edited, tests run, or artifacts published. Audited arrangement is a same-translation-unit module proposal. Private crossings remain visible as dependencies, not new public symbols. Separate compilation is not claimed.
